features.name: Traditional hunting interpretation is a curved wooden throwing stick.
Record hunting/nonreturning versus sport/returning selection; traditional hunting forms are not designed to return.

Assigned sole final reviewer inspected source-form-approved detail, actual clay, native foreground/openings, final2048 masks/teal views and paired overlay. Source-approved traditional non-returning curved hunting-stick interpretation. Actual gray clay removes wood grain/cracks/scratches and all tiny surface recesses; smooth broad curvature remains. No manual RGB edit, no invented flight behavior, no new component. Near-transparent glow seen in raw RGB preview lies outside actual visible alpha; alpha16/128 bounds agree within1..2pixels. Native1536x1024 for both roles. The large open concave curve remains exterior background, never a closed filled loop. Both solid wooden arms/tips and asymmetry remain; no extra hole or thinning. Existing independently reviewed alpha retained; only sub16/255 near-transparent background alpha is cleared by the unchanged standard route. Major source form/framing and solid arms, tips and open concave curve retained. No clipped part, detached subject, broad fringe or cast shadow. One common crop/scale/offset; original1536x1024 resampled2048 square, not native2K. Native RGB is unchanged from both original images.
